title: contract and solicitation opportunities - u.s. embassy and consulate in ecuador
paragraphs: please download and read this document before registering for any solicitation: how to register in sam.gov sam.gov is the system you must use to register as a vendor in order to participate in u.s. government contracting opportunities.

published on sam: august 12, 2026 site visit: august 27, 2026 offers submission deadline: september 11, 2026 the consulate intends to conduct a site visit on august 27, 2026, at 10h00 (local time) at the residence located in laguna club in via a la costa. prospective offerors interested in bidding and attending the site visit, must submit a list of complete names and id numbers of all participants to: penafielcd@state.gov with the subject line “19ec3026q0004 government owned house renovation” by 12:00 (local time) on august 26, 2026, no registration will be allowed after that time. more information about the requirements and how to apply at the following link: https://sam.gov/opp/7e0977cd77784df79212c0785f589605/view
